comment: Frozen oracle bundle for the native materializer spine, the stamp-step manifest writer and the per-recipe loop (GO-20 U2e T5 PR2-B S10). Captured once from the live Python 3.14.7 oracle (testdata/materialize_ref.py driving lib/_internal/recipe-materialize.py materialize_recipes) through the same in-package helpers the live differential used, twice with fresh roots and byte-identical records. Frozen properties per kind: spine = rc/stdout/stderr plus the requested documents (and the marker temp document); stamp = the seed manifest and the post-run manifest bytes; loop = rc/stdout/stderr, the documents and the ENTIRE project+cache file tree including the lock bytes. Host fixture roots are tokenized (<HOME>, <PROJECT>) with the inventory recorded per record; no traceback text is frozen. Restore from a pristine copy, never re-encode.
